method.patch: 7x7 per-channel median sRGB, then CIELAB D65; pixel coordinates are screenshot coordinates.
method.panels: Per-pixel CIELAB percentiles over bonnet semantic paint mask eroded six pixels with a 4-neighbour cross, excluding its shut line. Same mask rule for main, round 1 and round 2.
method.lampSummary: Median per-pixel CIELAB over the visible rear red lens zone. 7x7 patches are also reported individually, including lighter specular patches. Specular highlights are allowed to be less saturated than the lens median.
method.masks: Test-only unlit semantic masks; no product pass or map added.

limitations: Owner photographs were not attached/accessibly received; side-by-side owner-photo comparisons and exact lamp agreement cannot be verified.
Recovered source contains VXR / V8 grade lettering, while owner reports GXR. Source lettering is preserved exactly, not relabelled.
Source emblems/letters are open-backed relief shells. No literal closed back face exists to measure; mounting audit reports sampled exposed-shell clearances instead.
The latest bonnet total-spread cap takes precedence over round-one p95-minus-median target 4–6 L*: main total spread is below 2, so both targets cannot hold for the same pixel set.
